claims.label: PROVEN (negative on the method)
claims.statement: The hypothesis 'a covering reduced pair (A,B) of F2^m must have |A|,|B| both even' is FALSE; both-odd reduced covers exist. Therefore no dimension-free parity rule can exclude the both-odd splits (11,7)/(9,9).
claims.evidence: Complete m=3 reduced-covering census (all 2^8 x 2^8 subset pairs): both-odd splits (3,5),(3,7),(5,3),(5,5),(5,7),(7,3),(7,5),(7,7) all admit covers; (5,5) has 3136 covers, (7,7) has 64. Only (3,3) among small both-odd splits is empty.
claims.scope: Negative about the parity-kill METHOD, not about (11,7)/(9,9) themselves (which remain undecided/unexcluded).
